pass_b_english: “You made him a little lower than angels; with glory and honor you crowned him” (Psalm 8:6).

Of Eusebius. How the God of all crowned man with glory and honor, you will understand, because only of man it is written that God said: “Let us make man according to our image and according to likeness”; and God made the man; according to the image of God he made him (Genesis 1:26-27).

And he deemed him worthy of his own appearances, and to one clothed in flesh he imparted divine converse, then through angels, then also himself appearing through himself to the saints and giving oracles; and besides these he showed him a partaker of the Holy Spirit and of heavenly power, so as to foretell the future, and to heal all kinds of diseases, and already even to raise the dead; such things prophets and apostles are recorded to have done.
And if to all that was said you add the incarnate economy of the Only-begotten Son of God, you will see how it is said: “With glory and honor you crowned him,” namely, that you crowned man.

choices.why: The glory-and-honor crown is of man, including the incarnate economy. Not ‘namely the angels’.
rejected: namely the Son only, not man
